messages:
Aisha K: Quick sync 1 updated Q4/Q1 runway: projected demand Nov-Jan ~1.2M GPU-hours, we have ~800k committed. Rough gap ~400k. Considering shifting a tranche of L40S reservations to H200 for latency-sensitive traffic. cc @Sam P @Liam S
Sam P: FYI lead times: H200 ~14	6	20w, L40S ~6	6	10w. If we convert now H200 earliest shows up late Jan/Feb. Need budget sign-off. Which regions to target?
Liam S: Note: eu-west interconnect is the choke. Densifying H200 there caused 95p tail spikes last month. Options: upgrade rack uplinks 40Gb9100Gb or lower per-rack density.
Jun: Perf delta: H200 1.8x throughput for our 2k-token runs; for <=512 tokens it's ~1.25x. Hybrid mix looks better than full swap.
Nora: Reserved pricing: H200 2.2x $/hr vs L40S. But $/token may be lower due to higher throughput. I'll model cost-per-token across batching scenarios.
procurement-bot: Reservation draft RD-4271 created: 40 H200 (us-east), ETA 2026-02-08, est monthly delta +$110k. Cancellation penalty 15% within 30d.
Aisha K: Proposed quick plan: convert 25	6	30% of L40S headcount to H200. Regional split proposal: us-east 60%, eu-west 30%, apac 10%. Keep rest as L40S for massively parallel jobs.
Sam P: Need exact GPU counts to issue PO. If 30% of our active 400-node fleet -> approx 120 GPUs? Confirm racks vs GPU SKU mapping.
Liam S: For eu-west, moving 30% to H200 needs two racks upgraded to 100Gb uplinks. Ops time ~2 days/rack; we can parallelize across teams.
Jun: I'll run canary perf sims with blackfriday_prompts_v3 distribution and include KV-cache cold/cold-warm tails. Expect initial results Tue.
Nora: Short-term hedge: request cloud burst capacity (spot/burst pool) for ~120k	6	160k GPU-hours to cover Nov peak while hardware ships. Lower SLO but keeps features live.
Aisha K: Action items: 1) @Sam P get firm quotes + PO timeline incl customs buffer for APAC; 2) @Liam S validate rack/uplink ops and NIC tuning; 3) @Jun run perf sims + canary; 4) @Nora produce cost-per-token spreadsheets for 3 mixes. Acknowledge.
Sam P: Ack 1 will post vendor quotes and PO ETA by EOD Friday including secondary suppliers.
Liam S: Starting NIC/load tests now. Early telemetry: sustained batching saturates ~40Gb/s on current racks. 100Gb needed for densified H200. Sharing pcap and perf logs shortly.
Jun: Canary plan: deploy 8 H200 in staging with prod-like traffic, measure cold-KV tail & steady-state latency, then extend. Rollback hooks in place. Plan ready Wed.
Nora: Sensitivity note: from running sims, +20% batch size on H200 reduces per-token cost ~18%. I'll add sensitivity cases (batch, seq-len, cold-cache penalty).
procurement-bot: Quote uploaded: s3://procurement/quotes/H200_R1_v2.pdf
Aisha K: Also flag customs lead-time risk for APAC +2	6	3w. @Sam P include that buffer in ETA.
Sam P: Will add customs buffer and alternate carriers. Also negotiating partial-delivery terms to stagger invoices.
Liam S: Observed 12% retransmit/packet-loss on mixed-GPU racks during sustained KV writes last month. Strong argument to avoid mixed-type racks until NIC firmware/OS tuning complete.
Jun: :thumbsup: prepping orchestration for canary + automatic fallback to L40S pool if tails exceed threshold.
Nora: Procurement note: if partial cancellation allowed, we can redeploy some L40S into spot pools to avoid penalties and reduce waste.
Aisha K: OK reconvene Mon 10am PT with concrete numbers. Linking working doc: https://confluence.redwood/infa/q4-capacity-quickfill-plan :rocket:
